# ESH 27 (אש 27)

> ESH 27 is a multidisciplinary Israeli group: construction and engineering, technology and AI, Torah and culture tools, and consumer brands. Contact: +972-50-252-5066.

## Divisions
- [ESH27 Build & Facility · Farms](https://farms.esh27.com/): topographic map and control center for 130+ farms in Judea, Samaria and the Jordan Valley.
- [אומן המיזוג](https://esh27.com/vrf/): climate engineering and VRF air-conditioning systems.
- [מעבדת הצופן התורני](https://esh27.com/2701/): Torah letter-skip research tool, version 5.5.
- [ג'עלה – פיצוחים](https://jaale.esh27.com/): roasted nuts, dried fruit and gift boxes, Shavei Tzion 2, Ashdod.
- [נעמי אהרונוב](https://neomi.esh27.com/): beauty and care.
